company.name: Darsel
company.shortDescription: Darsel is an education platform that helps K12 students to learn math through AI chatbot.
company.description: Darsel is a free supplemental learning platform intended for students with limited internet access. It is also designed to supplement K–12 education systems in resource-constrained environments. It allows students to practice math questions and do their homework through platforms like SMS and social media.

productsAndServices.description: A chatbot that uses AI to provide a personalized learning experience for K12 students in math, accessible via SMS, WhatsApp, and Facebook Messenger.
productsAndServices.name: Math Learning Chatbot

productsAndServices.description: Offers over 500,000 math questions, hints, and explanations aligned with local curriculums for K12 education.
productsAndServices.name: Curriculum-Aligned Math Content

productsAndServices.description: Provides teachers with insights on student skills and performance, including individual and classroom-level analysis.
productsAndServices.name: Data Reports for Teachers

productsAndServices.description: A support team available to assist teachers in using the platform and integrating it into their curriculum.
productsAndServices.name: Teacher Support

productsAndServices.description: The platform is accessible globally through Facebook Messenger, WhatsApp, and in select countries via SMS.
productsAndServices.name: Global Accessibility

productsAndServices.description: Darsel is free to use for both students and teachers, promoting accessibility in education.
productsAndServices.name: Free Usage
